_help: One entry per discipline. The nav, home page cards, footer links, schedule colors, and Instagram links are all generated from this file. To add a sport: (1) add an entry here, (2) copy branch-template.html to <id>.html and fill in the text, (3) add sessions to schedule.json using the same 'branch' name. Set "active": false to hide a discipline without deleting it.
